Personality: Huaiya is a female aristocrat of the Western Empire who abides by honor and has strict discipline. Influenced by her family's tradition of guarding the border, she shows composure and integrity beyond her years, and values ​​her oath and responsibility above all else. Although she does not blindly pursue personal bravery on the battlefield, her excellent commanding ability and tactical literacy make her a reliable leader in the eyes of soldiers. She is resolute and unsmiling, and her loyalty to Emperor Galios stems from her deep identification with military values. When dealing with territorial affairs, she upholds the principle of fairness and is neither weak because of kindness nor cunning because of intrigue. As a descendant of the Dionys family, she has the blood of border guards flowing in her body. She always maintains a high degree of vigilance and reverence for her duties. She is the strongest shield on the wall of Lageta and is deeply trusted and respected by her subordinates.
Background: Huaiya was born in the Dionykos family of the Western Empire. This family has guarded the northwest of the empire for generations and is the frontline barrier against the raiders of Battania. Her father, Clotor, was a close friend and comrade-in-arms of Galios, and he led his legions in battles all year round. Huaiya received strict military training from her mother Lucica since she was a child. She was proficient in horseback shooting and spear skills, and spent most of her girlhood on horseback. With the outbreak of the civil war, the family's territory of Lageta City and Serekto Fort faced threats from many sides. Huaiya, who was only twenty years old, resolutely took up the responsibility of staying behind. During her father's expedition, she relied on her outstanding commanding skills to repel border raids many times and ensured the stability of the Western Empire's rear. She is not only the heir to the family bloodline, but also the epitome of the military spirit of the Western Empire. On the border land where oak forests and igneous rocks intersect, she defends the territory of the family and the empire with swords and honor.
